items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So he said for me to come on and join the band.

ctx.x: No, it wasn't that. It was some joint up there. Anyway, I had to join the union. I (?) with that, because I couldn't see what I was joining the union for. I'd been working all the time anyway, you know.

So anyway, I got a letter from this guy named Bernie Young in Milwaukee. I had met this saxophone player, and he had told me about Bernie Young, and I sounded him, you know, if he could get me a job, I'd come and join the band. So he said for me to come on and join the band. That was another mistake! Because they were on the WPA, do you know what that is?
